name: chi-sourcey-reference
description: Sourcey-generated community reference for the pinned go-chi/chi source.

scripts.snapshot: sourcey godoc --module vendor/chi --packages ./... --out godoc.json && node scripts/repair-snapshot.mjs
scripts.build: node scripts/repair-snapshot.mjs && sourcey build && node scripts/publish-output.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run validate && node scripts/publish-output.mjs --deploy
